an_intro:
...What a way to start off Kingdom Hearts 20th Anniversary, huh?

We're getting a continuation of Dark Roads and look more into Xehanort's journey. Cool. Didn't really get the chance to play Dark Roads, and I have a rough estimation of the plot. But it's interesting lore to watch.
an_missing_link_1: Kingdom Hearts Missing Link looks interesting, though I have mixed opinions about it. It's a mobile game, so gameplay isn't going to be the highest factor IMO. And based on what I'm looking at, I'm really kind of hoping for Kingdom Hearts Missing Link to be stylized like Pokemon Go. I want to run into fellow Kingdom Hearts fans in real life.
an_missing_link_2: I was kind of hoping for Kingdom Hearts Missing Link to be created for laptops/PCs. But as a Kingdom Hearts diehard fan, I'm just going to shamelessly enjoy whatever KH content I get.
an_missing_link_3: And once again, we're going to have our own charachter in Missing Links. Knowing what happened to our charachter in KHX...I'm really afraid to find out the fate of our KHML protagonist, or whatever connection our protagonist has with certain Kingdom Hearts characters. And last but not least...
an_kh4_hype:
KH4! KH4! KH4! KH4!

QUADRATRUM HERE WE COME!

AND OUR BOY SORA LOOKS SO GOOD! HE LOOKS MORE AND MORE LIKE A FINAL FANTASY CHARACTER! BUT NOOOOOO, HE'S PROGRESSIVELY LOSING HIS SPIKY HAIR!

AND THE GAMEPLAY! SORA HAS CHAINS! LET'S GO! AND HE IS CHANNELING THE POWERS OF GURREN LAGGAN TO DEFEAT THE DARKNESS!

I'M ON THE HYPE TRAIN! LET'S GOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
an_status:
*BREATHES DEEPLY AND EXHALES*

Whew, with that off my chest, 2022 is certainly looking interesting this year, for both good and bad for obvious reasons.

Now then, regarding the status of my fanfic, it's still going to continue on. Just keep in mind, like I said at the beginning, that this is completely AU to what KH4 has in store.
an_speculation_1:
That being said, I may or may not interconnect my fanfic with KH4 if we get enough info in the future.

Now I'm wondering...what kind of worlds are we going to encounter in Kingdom Hearts 4? Specifically, Quadratrum? Because to me, Quadratum doesn't seem to be limited to only Tokyo. I imagine other worlds are in the same plane as Tokyo.
an_speculation_2: There are many rumors and speculations that the MCU & Star Wars are involved in KH4. Personally, I don't mind seeing Sora fighting alongside the Avengers or engaging in a duel with Darth Vader. After all, Xemnas's powers are practically a reference to Darth Vader.
an_nier_vibes: Also, I'm getting some weird Drakengard/Nier vibes when I saw the Darkside(?) appear in Quadratum's Shibuya. You know, with giant monsters appearing out of nowhere in Japan (specifically Tokyo). It's also an interesting parallel/foil to how both series proceed.
an_nier_comparison: How the Grotesquerie Queen is purely white, while Darkside(?) is purely black. And yet somehow, I feel more hopeful with the dark demonic looking monster compared to the pure white humanoid 'angel', which I feel an immense amount of dread and horror.
an_outro: Well, see you in 2030 for KH4. Let's start the chapter.

sora31b: Sora answered with a flabbergasted look.
hestia3: Hestia: Thank goodness! When I see that elephant headed God, I'm going to-!
p100: Hestia started, but was soon cut off when Ganesha entered the scene.
ganesha27: Ganesha: Oh, Hestia! I certainly didn't expect you to visit at this time!
p101: Hestia comically snarled as she attempted to pounce at Ganesha, only to be held back by Bell.
bell4: Bell: Please Goddess, calm down before you do something that you'll regret!
bell4b: Bell desperately cried out as he was holding back his Goddess.
p102: Um... Sora looked a bit lost on why Hestia was angry with the God, but soon shook that off as he joined Bell in trying to calm down Hestia.
p103: Ganesha looked rather confused as to why Hestia is rather angry with him, while Shakti approached the scene while looking between her patron God and the angry Goddess before her.
p104: Suddenly, her mind clicked when she recognized what was going on.
p105: Shakti sighed while rubbing her forehead, and then turned to her patron God with a deadpanned look.
shakti11: Shakti: Lord Ganesha...did you forget to send one of our Familia members to inform Lady Hestia that we were going to talk to Sora?
p106: As soon as Ganesha heard the question, he froze a bit and went silent.
p107: Stiffly, he turned his head away while sweating a bit.
ganesha28: Ganesha: I...Ganesha...may have neglected that part...
p108: Shakti promptly face palmed upon hearing this.
p109: After the whole situation has calmed down, everyone was led to Ganesha's office once more.
p110: On Ganesha's side, Ganesha was giving a sheepish laugh while scratching the back of his head, while Shakti looked rather apologetic at what occurred.
p111: On the Hestia Familia's side, Hestia was in a rather bad mood as she was glaring at Ganesha, while Bell could only mirror Shakti and be apologetic on their behalf.
p112: Meanwhile, Sora was just staring at his Familia with confused and lost expression.
sora32: Sora: So...how exactly did all of this happen?
bell5b: Bell started while looking rather embarrassed.
p113: When Sora left the group, Bell immediately headed to the Guild and exchanged the magic stones for Valis.
p114: As soon as he was done, he parted ways with Lili and made a beeline towards their home and informed Hestia on what just happened.
p115: As soon as the Goddess was told of this, she exploded into fury and immediately went for a beeline towards Ganesha's home base, with Bell following after her.
p116: As soon as she arrived, she was met with the front gates being closed and one of the guard asking what her business is.
p117: She demanded to speak to Ganesha, to which the guard responded that Ganesha is currently busy at the moment (speaking to Sora).
p118: She didn't take kindly to that answer, and then proceeded to choke the guard and demand to let her through.
sora33b: Sora lets out while looking befuddled upon learning about this.
sora33c: Sora: I didn't think she'd react this badly to me being taken away...
bell6: Bell: I-I'm really sorry for what my Goddess did!
bell6b: Bell cried out while bowing in apology towards Ganesha.
p119: Ganesha, on the other hand, simply gave a hearty laugh, showing that he's not at all offended.
ganesha29: Ganesha: Ha ha ha! It's alright! This misunderstanding was an error on my part.
ganesha30: Ganesha: In hindsight, I should've talked to Hestia first before I brought Sora in. I was just rather eager to learn about the Heartless from Sora!
p120: As soon as Ganesha said that, the Hestia Familia (save for Sora) froze upon hearing this.
p121: Bell paled a bit upon hearing this. Hestia froze in her spot as well, before she stiffly turned towards Sora with an unreadable expression.
hestia5b: Hestia questioned with a stiff expression.
p122: Sora gave a sheepish and nervous chuckle as he scratched his cheek.
sora34: Sora: I...voluntarily told Ganesha about the Heartless.
p123: Silence rung throughout the room, before Hestia proceeded to close the distance between her and Sora and proceeded to shake him around in comical fury.
hestia6: Hestia: Why!? After all the effort we're going through to keep this under wraps, you just decided to reveal it like that!? That defeats the whole purpose of what you're supposed to be doing!
sora35b: Sora sputtered as he was being throttled by the Goddess before him.
sora_thought9b: when he finds out that I'm breaking the rules!'
sora_thought9c: And if I know anything about Donald, it'll take some time for her to calm down...!
bell7b: Bell exclaimed as he once again had to serve as the placater to Hestia's fury.
p124: Fortunately for Sora, Ganesha decided to speak up to spare the boy from his Goddess's fury.
ganesha31b: Ganesha called out to the Goddess of the Hearth, making Hestia momentarily stop shaking Sora and turn her attention towards him.
ganesha32: Ganesha: I understand all too well why Sora wanted to keep the Heartless hidden. Information like this is too sensitive to share, and could cause public discord if news of the Heartless were to spread.
ganesha32b: Ganesha told the Goddess, before he folded his arms.
ganesha33: Ganesha: However! Please be assured that I, Ganesha, already promised Sora that I will not share this information about the Heartless to the public or anyone else for that matter! And because of his duties to defeat the Heartless, I, Ganesha, fully intend on supporting Sora and his endeavors against the Heartless in order to keep the city safe!
p125: This made Bell look at the God in surprise, while Sora gave a grin in appreciation for the support the God of the Masses is giving him.
p126: Hearing all of this come from Ganesha made Hestia pause and stare at Ganesha for a bit, before she gave a sigh and lets Sora go from her grasp.
hestia7: Hestia: *Sigh*...Honestly, we're supposed to keep this under wraps and not let anyone else know about the Heartless. But I guess it's too late for that. I guess I have no choice but to accept this. It could've been worse if Sora told any other God. But with you, it's the least consequential.
ganesha34: Ganesha: I, Ganesha, am glad to have your approval!
ganesha34b: Ganesha heartily replied with a grin.
shakti12: Shakti: Thank you for your acceptance, Lady Hestia.
shakti12b: Shakti replied as while bowing in thanks.
sora36: Sora: Thank goodness that's settled with.
sora36b: Sora said with relief, making Bell nod in agreement with him.
p127: Hestia, however, simply cleared her throat, showing that she's not done yet.
hestia8: Hestia: Even with this approval, there need to be a few ground rules if our Familias are going to work together.
hestia8b: Hestia declared, making Bell and Sora look at her in surprise, while Ganesha simply nodded in understanding.
ganesha35: Ganesha: Fair enough. What sort of rules do we need to establish?
hestia9: Hestia: While I can't name everything at the moment, the first thing that needs to be said is that whatever activity that you're going to involve Sora in, you need to tell me as well. My child doesn't mind helping you out with the Heartless, but I certainly don't want him to be exploited for his power!
hestia9b: Hestia stated with a serious tone.
ganesha36: Ganesha: Of course! I, Ganesha, would never dream of such a thing! My Familia and I are more than happy to receive Sora's assistance, rather than exploit him for our benefit! Our goals align in protecting the masses, after all!
ganesha36b: Ganesha declared, making Hestia sigh in relief upon hearing this.
hestia10: Hestia: Good. Then concerning how we'll go from here...

p128: The meeting between Hestia and Ganesha lasted for a good amount of time, before both parties found the agreement and rules between them to be of satisfactory.
p129: As of now, the Hestia and Ganesha Familia are in an unofficial and unspoken alliance when it comes to the Heartless.
p130: When the meeting came to an end, they were let go from Ganesha's Familia and headed home.
p131: The trio were currently walking through the streets of Orario, with the magic light lamps lighting up the streets as night has already fallen.
hestia11: Hestia: Honestly, I thought that meeting was going to last all night...
sora37: Sora: I'm just glad we were able to resolve it without any issue.
sora37b: Sora said with a grin as he crossed his arms behind his head.
bell8b: Bell muttered, his mind still lingering how it could've been an issue if he wasn't there to hold back his Goddess's wrath.
hestia12b: Hestia said as she turned towards Sora with a complex expression.
hestia12c: Hestia: I know that I've agreed to work with Ganesha, but I'm still having some doubts about this. Sora, are you positive that it's a good idea to trust Ganesha with the information about the Heartless? As a Keyblade wielder, you're supposed to keep everything about you under wraps. Why did you decide to confess it to a God that you just met?
p132: Hearing that question made the islander hum while folding his arms in thought.
sora38: Sora: Well, at first, I wanted to keep the Heartless under wraps as well. But after talking with Ganesha, I came to realize he isn't like the other Gods at all. He's the God of Masses, so he's more interested in protecting the people rather than try to exploit me for my powers like other Gods. So our interest align with each other.
hestia13: Hestia: Even if that is the case, you could've given some half truths about the Heartless, like how they're abnormal monsters and just leave it at that. But you decided to give the full truth about the Heartless and their potential for mass destruction.
sora39: Sora: Well, yeah, but I believe being honest with each other will help build up a strong relationship between us. Plus, I believe informing Ganesha of the truth will be beneficial for us in the long run.
sora39b: Sora explained, making Hestia look confused upon hearing this.
hestia14: Hestia: W-What do you mean by beneficial?
sora40: Sora: Well, I can't be everywhere at once. Once I'm in the Dungeon, I have no knowledge on what's occurring on the surface. The Heartless may attack the citizens while I'm gone. The Ganesha Familia will help keep a lookout for the Heartless, and they'll update me on any Heartless activity.
hestia15: Hestia: Y-You make a valid point. But still, it's rather risky to entrust Ganesha with this type of information. He may learn about how you're not from this world.
sora41: Sora: I wouldn't worry too much about that. I haven't given him any information regarding my origins. And besides, I feel Ganesha isn't going to dig too much into my background. Ganesha is a cool guy once you get to know him.
p134: Hestia stared at Sora with a bit of disbelief, as she can't believe Sora finds a weird and eccentric God like Ganesha 'cool'.
p135: Then again, with someone like Sora who possesses such an out-of-this-world common sense and perspective, it's only natural that Sora gets along with those types of people.
p136: Hestia soon shook that off and she sighed in an exhausted manner.
hestia16: Hestia: ...If you're sure, that's fine then...
hestia16c: Hestia: I suppose it could've been worse. At least
hestia16d: or some other God didn't drag you away and demand the truth out of you.
p137: It was then Bell found it the perfect time to bring up a topic that has been on his mind.

bell9b: Bell curiously asked, making Sora nod at Bell.
sora43: Sora: Yeah, Ganesha has told me that there have been reports of unusual tremors that have been occurring in a certain section of Orario. They're having a rather difficult time trying to track down the source of the tremors, and he wants me to check it out and see if it's related to the Heartless.
bell10b: Bell muttered while gaining a pensive look, trying to figure out if that is related to Heartless activity.
hestia17: Hestia: Do you think it's possible Sora?

hestia18: Hestia: I suppose that's the point of investigating.
hestia18c: Hestia: Is there anyone else coming to investigate the tremors?

sora45b: Sora revealed, making Bell and Hestia look at Sora in shock.
hestia19: Hestia: Ganesha is sending his Captain alongside you!? That seems like overkill if you ask me!? And why didn't he tell me during that meeting!?
hestia19b: Hestia exclaimed in shock and irritation.
sora46: Sora: Well, he said that he wants the Captain to gain experience on what it's like to deal with Heartless, and having her learn from me about the Heartless will help them gain a better understanding on the patterns of Heartless. p138: Hestia groaned while rubbing her forehead.
hestia20: Hestia: Honestly, we're already dragging in people from high places into our business already, and it hasn't even been a month since you joined our Familia.
p139: Meanwhile, Bell gained a determined expression as he turned to Sora.
bell11: Bell: If Heartless are lurking in the city, then I should help out as well-
sora47: Sora: Actually Bell, I need you to do me a favor and keep an eye on the Dungeon for me.
sora47b: Sora cut off Bell, making Bell look at Sora in shock.
bell12b: Bell responded with shock and confusion.
sora48: Sora: Heh heh, out of nowhere, huh?
sora48b: Sora chuckled as he scratched his cheek.
bell13c: Bell: What exactly do you mean keep an eye on the Dungeon?
sora49: Sora: Well, here's the thing. The Heartless are attracted to me with the Keyblade. Even if that's the case, the Heartless do things on their own when I'm not around. hestia21c: Hestia: Isn't it dangerous to have Bell dive into the Dungeon alone and face the Heartless? I know Bell has been growing a lot as of late, and his stats are already in the above average for a Level 1, but it's still rather risky, isn't it?

sora51: Sora: I trust you can keep an eye on things. Plus, even if the Heartless don't show up, which is a good thing, you can use that time to practice with your Trancheuse.

p140: Now that Sora has pointed it out, his knife throwing skills could really use some work, considering how his success rate with them is below-average.
p141: And considering the fast-pace battles and environment that Bell often finds himself in, he doesn't exactly have the leisure to properly adjust his throwing.
bell_thought2: Bell: 'Perhaps taking a step back might be best for me...'
bell_thought2b: Bell thought, seeing how he needs to step away from intense battles at the moment and focus on a lighter practice environment to hone his skills.
p142: Seeing the benefits from this, as well as the fact that Sora has enough faith in him to keep an eye on the Heartless while he's not around has already made Bell feel even more driven to go forth with his given task.
p143: Bell gave a determined nod towards Sora.
bell15: Bell: Right! I'll do my best!
p144: Hestia looked rather hesitant when she heard Bell's answer for a couple of reasons.
p145: The first reason is that Bell could be fighting the Heartless on his own if the Heartless do decided to move up floors.
p146: Sure, he's been improving a lot lately and his the best equipment to handle them, but the Heartless are monsters that you cannot underestimate.
p147: Reason why Bell lasted this long is due to the fact that Sora is around to make sure things are alright.
p148: But considering the fact that Bell is going to stick to the floors that have been liberated from the Heartless, she supposes it's safe.
p149: The second reason is that Bell and Sora are going to be separate from each other.
p150: She needs Sora and Bell to be together in order for Sora's Link to All to improve Bell's already ridiculous growth.
p151: If they far apart from each other, then Bell won't grow as much.
hestia_thought1: Hestia: 'Though, Bell's own Skill is nothing to sneeze at either...'
hestia_thought1b: Hestia thought, her mind recalling Liaris Freese.
p152: Bell will certainly grow bigger than anyone else, but not as much as before without Sora's Link to All.
p153: And now that she thought about it, they're just going to spend a day apart from each other.
p154: It's not going to hurt that much in the overall grand scheme of things.
p155: It was upon those thoughts that Hestia decided to let them do what they're planning, but not without giving Bell proper warning.
hestia22: Hestia: Even though Sora is entrusting you to keep on eye on the upper floors Bell, make sure you don't bite off more than you can chew! Do not, under any circumstances, enter the 9th floor on your own! And if the Heartless are moving up and the numbers and strength are against you, do not hesitate to run! That's Sora's job to take care of them!
bell16b: Bell straightened up when hearing this from his Goddess.
p156: Pleased to hear the answer from her first and beloved child, Hestia then turned to Sora.
hestia23: Hestia: As for you Sora, make sure you give only the appropriate amount of information to Ganesha's Captain. We don't want Ganesha and his Familia pick up any clues about your origins. Or worse, just you spilling everything about you.
sora52: Sora: Hey, I'm not that hopeless! I know how to keep secrets when needed!
p157: Hestia gave him a flat stare, telling him she doesn't buy it.
p158: She leaves him alone for a moment and Sora has already revealed the truth about the Heartless to another God, despite the benefits coming from it.
p159: She cannot be blamed for feeling this way towards Sora.
p160: Hestia sighed while rubbing her forehead.
p161: Why is it that she's putting in the most effort to keep Sora's status a secret, when Sora himself should be doing it instead?
hestia_thought2: Hestia: 'This Keyblade wielder is more trouble than he is worth...'
hestia_thought2b: Hestia thought with a mental groan.
p162: She could already feel another headache forming.
author_note_start: And that's a wrap to this chapter.
author_note_p1: Once again, not the most exciting of chapters, but I promise you that this chapter is the buildup to something exciting, which is gonna happen next chapter.
author_note_p2a: Originally, I was going to write the chapter with Sora and Ganesha finishing their meeting, and then have Sora return home and tell Hestia and Bell what happened afterwards.
author_note_p2b: But <u>TheBeatles211</u> has suggested a rather fun idea/segment to add in where Hestia is quite furious with Ganesha on how he practically took Sora to him without consulting with her first, and barge in.
author_note_p2c: But I modified it a bit.
author_note_p3a: Also, originally, I was going to write dialogue between Sora and Ganesha, with Sora explaining about the Heartless.
author_note_p3b: But I soon found that a chore, and 95% of the conversation was just Sora explaining and Ganesha being shocked and confused with the information.
author_note_p3c: It looked to be pretty boring and repetitive, so I've decided to just summarize the conversation.
author_note_p4a: So yeah, Sora filled in Ganesha about the Heartless, which is honestly a good call, considering how Ganesha is a really benevolent God compared to the rest of the other Gods.
author_note_p4b: He is a God who genuinely cares about the masses and protecting the innocent, just like Sora.
author_note_p4c: So of course their goals would align with each other.
author_note_p4d: And because of this, Ganesha has already gave Sora some work in Orario.
author_note_p4e: Sora now has the Ganesha Familia backing his efforts in suppressing the Heartless. Quite an upgrade for our Keyblade Wielder.
fun_fact_p1: Nomura confirmed at the 20th Anniversary event that he heavily considered making a Verum Rex game, after the in-universe video game of the same name from Kingdom Hearts III, before the fourth numbered installment, focused on Yozora and the cast of characters from his universe.
fun_fact_p2: He decided against it out of fear it would confuse players, worry fans of Sora, and push development of Kingdom Hearts IV further back after III spent a considerable amount of time in Development Hell.
fun_fact_p3: ...Perhaps we would get a Verum Rex spin off in the future? Fingers crossed.
